complete_declarations.name: auxiliaryCharacterSum_changeLevel_absorb
complete_declarations.complete_header:
private theorem auxiliaryCharacterSum_changeLevel_absorb
    (d : MediumAtom) (k : ℕ) {f delta : ℕ} (hfd : f ∣ delta)
    (psi : DirichletCharacter ℂ f) :
    auxiliaryCharacterSum d.alphaCarrier d.alpha k delta
        (DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hfd psi) =
      ∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier,
        if n.Coprime (k * delta) then d.alpha n * star (psi (n : ZMod f)) else 0
complete_declarations.complete_proof:
:= by
  unfold auxiliaryCharacterSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n _
  by_cases hnd : n.Coprime delta
  · have he : (DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hfd psi) (n : ZMod delta) =
        psi (n : ZMod f) := by
      simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using
        (DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd' psi hfd
          (Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.mpr hnd))
    rw [he]
    by_cases hnk : n.Coprime k
    · rw [if_pos hnk, if_pos (hnk.mul_right hnd)]
    · have hnK : ¬n.Coprime (k * delta) :=
        fun h => hnk (Nat.coprime_mul_iff_right.mp h).1
      rw [if_neg hnk, if_neg hnK]
  · have hnu : ¬IsUnit (n : ZMod delta) :=
      fun h => hnd ((ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime n delta).mp h)
    have hnK : ¬n.Coprime (k * delta) :=
      fun h => hnd (Nat.coprime_mul_iff_right.mp h).2
    rw [MulChar.map_nonunit _ hnu, star_zero, mul_zero, if_neg hnK]
    exact ite_self 0

complete_declarations.name: character_auxSW_expansion
complete_declarations.complete_header:
private theorem character_auxSW_expansion
    (d : MediumAtom) (K : ℕ) {f : ℕ} [NeZero f]
    (psi : DirichletCharacter ℂ f) (hpsi : psi ≠ 1) :
    (∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier,
      if n.Coprime K then d.alpha n * star (psi (n : ZMod f)) else 0) =
        ∑ b : ZMod f, star (psi b) * d.auxSWError K f b.val
complete_declarations.complete_proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ b : ZMod f, star (psi b)) = 0 := by
    rw [← star_sum, MulChar.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one hpsi, star_zero]
  let center : ℂ := (∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier,
    if n.Coprime (K * f) then d.alpha n else 0) / (f.totient : ℂ)
  have hcenter : (∑ b : ZMod f, star (psi b) * center) = 0 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum, zero_mul]
  symm
  change (∑ b : ZMod f, star (psi b) *
    ((∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier,
      if Nat.ModEq f n b.val ∧ n.Coprime K then d.alpha n else 0) - center)) = _
  simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [hcenter, sub_zero]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n _
  by_cases hn : n.Coprime K
  · rw [if_pos hn]
    calc
      _ = star (psi (n : ZMod f)) * d.alpha n := by
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (n : ZMod f)]
        · have hm : Nat.ModEq f n (n : ZMod f).val := by
            apply (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff n (n : ZMod f).val f).mp
            exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (n : ZMod f)).symm
          have hgate : Nat.ModEq f n (n : ZMod f).val ∧ n.Coprime K := ⟨hm, hn⟩
          rw [if_pos hgate]
        · intro b _ hne
          have hm : ¬Nat.ModEq f n b.val := by
            intro h
            have he := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff n b.val f).mpr h
            rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] at he
            exact hne he.symm
          have hgate : ¬(Nat.ModEq f n b.val ∧ n.Coprime K) := fun h => hm h.1
          rw [if_neg hgate, mul_zero]
        · intro hnot
          exact (hnot (Finset.mem_univ _)).elim
      _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
  · simp only [hn, and_false, if_false, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

complete_declarations.complete_header:
private theorem auxiliaryCharacterSum_norm_le_conductor
    (d : MediumAtom) (k : ℕ) {delta : ℕ} (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (chi : DirichletCharacter ℂ delta) (hchi : chi ≠ 1)
    {E : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (herr : ∀ b : ℕ, b.Coprime chi.conductor →
      ‖d.auxSWError (k * delta) chi.conductor b‖ ≤ E) :
    ‖auxiliaryCharacterSum d.alphaCarrier d.alpha k delta chi‖ ≤
      (chi.conductor : ℝ) * E
complete_declarations.complete_proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero delta := ⟨hdelta.ne'⟩
  letI : NeZero chi.conductor := ⟨chi.conductor_ne_zero⟩
  have hpsi : chi.primitiveCharacter ≠ 1 := by
    intro he
    apply hchi
    rw [← chi.changeLevel_primitiveCharacter, he, map_one]
  have heq : auxiliaryCharacterSum d.alphaCarrier d.alpha k delta chi =
      ∑ b : ZMod chi.conductor,
        star (chi.primitiveCharacter b) * d.auxSWError (k * delta) chi.conductor b.val := by
    simpa only [chi.changeLevel_primitiveCharacter] using
      auxiliaryCharacterSum_changeLevel_eq_auxSW d k chi.conductor_dvd_level
        chi.primitiveCharacter hpsi
  rw [heq]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ b : ZMod chi.conductor,
        ‖star (chi.primitiveCharacter b) * d.auxSWError (k * delta) chi.conductor b.val‖ :=
      norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _b : ZMod chi.conductor, E := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro b _
      by_cases hb : IsUnit b
      · have hb' : b.val.Coprime chi.conductor := by
          apply (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime b.val chi.conductor).mp
          simpa only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using hb
        calc
          _ = ‖chi.primitiveCharacter b‖ *
              ‖d.auxSWError (k * delta) chi.conductor b.val‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul, norm_star]
          _ ≤ 1 * E := mul_le_mul (chi.primitiveCharacter.norm_le_one b)
            (herr b.val hb') (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
          _ = E := one_mul E
      · rw [chi.primitiveCharacter.map_nonunit hb, star_zero, zero_mul, norm_zero]
        exact hE
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.card]

theorem uniformAuxiliarySW_lowConductor_auxiliaryCharacterSum
    {ι : Type*} (F : ι → MediumAtom) (B C0 : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ)
    (hadmissible : ∀ i, MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 (F i))
    (hSW : UniformAuxiliarySW F C0) :
    ∀ A L : ℝ, 0 < A → 0 ≤ L →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧
        ∀ i : ι, x0 ≤ (F i).scale → ∀ k delta : ℕ,
          1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ delta → ∀ chi : DirichletCharacter ℂ delta,
          chi ≠ 1 → (chi.conductor : ℝ) ≤ (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ L →
          ‖auxiliaryCharacterSum (F i).alphaCarrier (F i).alpha k delta chi‖ ≤
            C * (F i).U * (((k * delta).divisors.card : ℝ) ^ C0) /
              (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ A
complete_declarations.complete_proof:
:= by
  intro A L hA hL
  obtain ⟨C, hC, x0, hx0, hbound⟩ := hSW (A + L) (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hA hL)
  refine ⟨C, hC, x0, hx0, ?_⟩
  intro i hx k delta hk hdelta chi hchi hconductor
  letI : NeZero delta := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hf : 1 ≤ chi.conductor := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr chi.conductor_ne_zero
  have hK : 1 ≤ k * delta := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    (mul_ne_zero (by omega : k ≠ 0) (by omega : delta ≠ 0))
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log (F i).scale := Real.log_pos (hx0.trans_le hx)
  let E : ℝ := C * (F i).U * (((k * delta).divisors.card : ℝ) ^ C0) /
    (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ (A + L)
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := by
    dsimp only [E]
    exact div_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC.le (by linarith [(hadmissible i).1]))
        (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _))
      (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlog _).le
  calc
    _ ≤ (chi.conductor : ℝ) * E :=
      SharedFirstFactorLowConductorSW.auxiliaryCharacterSum_norm_le_conductor
        (F i) k (by omega) chi hchi hE
        (fun b hb => hbound i hx (k * delta) chi.conductor b hK hf hb)
    _ ≤ (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ L * E :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hconductor hE
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [E]
      rw [Real.rpow_add hlog A L]
      field_simp [(Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlog A).ne',
        (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlog L).ne']
      ring

import ImbalancedChen.Part3SharedFirstFactorCharacterDictionary

/-!
# The actual auxiliary character sum at low conductor

The nonunit restriction at the full character level is retained in the
auxiliary parameter k * delta. For the shared-first-factor dictionary,
k = v / D and delta = p * D give k * delta = p * v. The divisor cost below
is therefore the cost of that full physical modulus.

This leaf proves a pointwise low-conductor bound from the original
UniformAuxiliarySW. It does not sum the physical labels or pay a zero mode.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen.Part3

noncomputable section

open Classical Finset
open scoped BigOperators
open SharedFirstFactorCharacterDictionary

namespace SharedFirstFactorLowConductorSW

/-- Changing the character level keeps its nonunits in the auxiliary sieve. -/
private theorem auxiliaryCharacterSum_changeLevel_absorb
    (d : MediumAtom) (k : ℕ) {f delta : ℕ} (hfd : f ∣ delta)
    (psi : DirichletCharacter ℂ f) :
    auxiliaryCharacterSum d.alphaCarrier d.alpha k delta
        (DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hfd psi) =
      ∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier,
        if n.Coprime (k * delta) then d.alpha n * star (psi (n : ZMod f)) else 0 := by
  unfold auxiliaryCharacterSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n _
  by_cases hnd : n.Coprime delta
  · have he : (DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hfd psi) (n : ZMod delta) =
        psi (n : ZMod f) := by
      simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using
        (DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd' psi hfd
          (Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.mpr hnd))
    rw [he]
    by_cases hnk : n.Coprime k
    · rw [if_pos hnk, if_pos (hnk.mul_right hnd)]
    · have hnK : ¬n.Coprime (k * delta) :=
        fun h => hnk (Nat.coprime_mul_iff_right.mp h).1
      rw [if_neg hnk, if_neg hnK]
  · have hnu : ¬IsUnit (n : ZMod delta) :=
      fun h => hnd ((ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime n delta).mp h)
    have hnK : ¬n.Coprime (k * delta) :=
      fun h => hnd (Nat.coprime_mul_iff_right.mp h).2
    rw [MulChar.map_nonunit _ hnu, star_zero, mul_zero, if_neg hnK]
    exact ite_self 0

/-- The principal AP center cancels against a nonprincipal character. -/
private theorem character_auxSW_expansion
    (d : MediumAtom) (K : ℕ) {f : ℕ} [NeZero f]
    (psi : DirichletCharacter ℂ f) (hpsi : psi ≠ 1) :
    (∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier,
      if n.Coprime K then d.alpha n * star (psi (n : ZMod f)) else 0) =
        ∑ b : ZMod f, star (psi b) * d.auxSWError K f b.val := by
  have hsum : (∑ b : ZMod f, star (psi b)) = 0 := by
    rw [← star_sum, MulChar.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one hpsi, star_zero]
  let center : ℂ := (∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier,
    if n.Coprime (K * f) then d.alpha n else 0) / (f.totient : ℂ)
  have hcenter : (∑ b : ZMod f, star (psi b) * center) = 0 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum, zero_mul]
  symm
  change (∑ b : ZMod f, star (psi b) *
    ((∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier,
      if Nat.ModEq f n b.val ∧ n.Coprime K then d.alpha n else 0) - center)) = _
  simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [hcenter, sub_zero]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n _
  by_cases hn : n.Coprime K
  · rw [if_pos hn]
    calc
      _ = star (psi (n : ZMod f)) * d.alpha n := by
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (n : ZMod f)]
        · have hm : Nat.ModEq f n (n : ZMod f).val := by
            apply (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff n (n : ZMod f).val f).mp
            exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (n : ZMod f)).symm
          have hgate : Nat.ModEq f n (n : ZMod f).val ∧ n.Coprime K := ⟨hm, hn⟩
          rw [if_pos hgate]
        · intro b _ hne
          have hm : ¬Nat.ModEq f n b.val := by
            intro h
            have he := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff n b.val f).mpr h
            rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] at he
            exact hne he.symm
          have hgate : ¬(Nat.ModEq f n b.val ∧ n.Coprime K) := fun h => hm h.1
          rw [if_neg hgate, mul_zero]
        · intro hnot
          exact (hnot (Finset.mem_univ _)).elim
      _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
  · simp only [hn, and_false, if_false, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

private theorem auxiliaryCharacterSum_changeLevel_eq_auxSW
    (d : MediumAtom) (k : ℕ) {f delta : ℕ} [NeZero f]
    (hfd : f ∣ delta) (psi : DirichletCharacter ℂ f) (hpsi : psi ≠ 1) :
    auxiliaryCharacterSum d.alphaCarrier d.alpha k delta
        (DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hfd psi) =
      ∑ b : ZMod f, star (psi b) * d.auxSWError (k * delta) f b.val := by
  rw [auxiliaryCharacterSum_changeLevel_absorb d k hfd psi]
  exact character_auxSW_expansion d (k * delta) psi hpsi

/-- A finite norm budget, retaining the full level inside the SW parameter. -/
private theorem auxiliaryCharacterSum_norm_le_conductor
    (d : MediumAtom) (k : ℕ) {delta : ℕ} (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (chi : DirichletCharacter ℂ delta) (hchi : chi ≠ 1)
    {E : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (herr : ∀ b : ℕ, b.Coprime chi.conductor →
      ‖d.auxSWError (k * delta) chi.conductor b‖ ≤ E) :
    ‖auxiliaryCharacterSum d.alphaCarrier d.alpha k delta chi‖ ≤
      (chi.conductor : ℝ) * E := by
  letI : NeZero delta := ⟨hdelta.ne'⟩
  letI : NeZero chi.conductor := ⟨chi.conductor_ne_zero⟩
  have hpsi : chi.primitiveCharacter ≠ 1 := by
    intro he
    apply hchi
    rw [← chi.changeLevel_primitiveCharacter, he, map_one]
  have heq : auxiliaryCharacterSum d.alphaCarrier d.alpha k delta chi =
      ∑ b : ZMod chi.conductor,
        star (chi.primitiveCharacter b) * d.auxSWError (k * delta) chi.conductor b.val := by
    simpa only [chi.changeLevel_primitiveCharacter] using
      auxiliaryCharacterSum_changeLevel_eq_auxSW d k chi.conductor_dvd_level
        chi.primitiveCharacter hpsi
  rw [heq]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ b : ZMod chi.conductor,
        ‖star (chi.primitiveCharacter b) * d.auxSWError (k * delta) chi.conductor b.val‖ :=
      norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _b : ZMod chi.conductor, E := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro b _
      by_cases hb : IsUnit b
      · have hb' : b.val.Coprime chi.conductor := by
          apply (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime b.val chi.conductor).mp
          simpa only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using hb
        calc
          _ = ‖chi.primitiveCharacter b‖ *
              ‖d.auxSWError (k * delta) chi.conductor b.val‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul, norm_star]
          _ ≤ 1 * E := mul_le_mul (chi.primitiveCharacter.norm_le_one b)
            (herr b.val hb') (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
          _ = E := one_mul E
      · rw [chi.primitiveCharacter.map_nonunit hb, star_zero, zero_mul, norm_zero]
        exact hE
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.card]

end SharedFirstFactorLowConductorSW

/-- The original auxiliary SW constants pay a fixed polylogarithmic conductor.
The auxiliary divisor penalty is that of k * delta, including every nonunit gate. -/
theorem uniformAuxiliarySW_lowConductor_auxiliaryCharacterSum
    {ι : Type*} (F : ι → MediumAtom) (B C0 : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ)
    (hadmissible : ∀ i, MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 (F i))
    (hSW : UniformAuxiliarySW F C0) :
    ∀ A L : ℝ, 0 < A → 0 ≤ L →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧
        ∀ i : ι, x0 ≤ (F i).scale → ∀ k delta : ℕ,
          1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ delta → ∀ chi : DirichletCharacter ℂ delta,
          chi ≠ 1 → (chi.conductor : ℝ) ≤ (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ L →
          ‖auxiliaryCharacterSum (F i).alphaCarrier (F i).alpha k delta chi‖ ≤
            C * (F i).U * (((k * delta).divisors.card : ℝ) ^ C0) /
              (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ A := by
  intro A L hA hL
  obtain ⟨C, hC, x0, hx0, hbound⟩ := hSW (A + L) (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hA hL)
  refine ⟨C, hC, x0, hx0, ?_⟩
  intro i hx k delta hk hdelta chi hchi hconductor
  letI : NeZero delta := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hf : 1 ≤ chi.conductor := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr chi.conductor_ne_zero
  have hK : 1 ≤ k * delta := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    (mul_ne_zero (by omega : k ≠ 0) (by omega : delta ≠ 0))
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log (F i).scale := Real.log_pos (hx0.trans_le hx)
  let E : ℝ := C * (F i).U * (((k * delta).divisors.card : ℝ) ^ C0) /
    (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ (A + L)
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := by
    dsimp only [E]
    exact div_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC.le (by linarith [(hadmissible i).1]))
        (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _))
      (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlog _).le
  calc
    _ ≤ (chi.conductor : ℝ) * E :=
      SharedFirstFactorLowConductorSW.auxiliaryCharacterSum_norm_le_conductor
        (F i) k (by omega) chi hchi hE
        (fun b hb => hbound i hx (k * delta) chi.conductor b hK hf hb)
    _ ≤ (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ L * E :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hconductor hE
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [E]
      rw [Real.rpow_add hlog A L]
      field_simp [(Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlog A).ne',
        (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlog L).ne']
      ring

end

abbrev DirichletCharacter (R : Type*) [CommMonoidWithZero R] (n : ℕ) := MulChar (ZMod n) R

open MulChar

variable {R : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero R] {n : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter R n)

/-- A function that modifies the level of a Dirichlet character to some multiple
  of its original level. -/
noncomputable def changeLevel {n m : ℕ} (hm : n ∣ m) :
    DirichletCharacter R n →* DirichletCharacter R m where
  toFun ψ := MulChar.ofUnitHom (ψ.toUnitHom.comp (ZMod.unitsMap hm))
  map_one' := by ext; simp
  map_mul' ψ₁ ψ₂ := by ext; simp

lemma changeLevel_def {m : ℕ} (hm : n ∣ m) :
    changeLevel hm χ = MulChar.ofUnitHom (χ.toUnitHom.comp (ZMod.unitsMap hm)) := rfl

lemma changeLevel_trans {m d : ℕ} (hm : n ∣ m) (hd : m ∣ d) :
    changeLevel (dvd_trans hm hd) χ = changeLevel hd (changeLevel hm χ) := by
  simp [changeLevel_def, MonoidHom.comp_assoc, ZMod.unitsMap_comp]

lemma changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd {m : ℕ} (hm : n ∣ m) (a : Units (ZMod m)) :
    (changeLevel hm χ) a = χ (ZMod.cast (a : ZMod m)) := by
  simp [changeLevel_def, ZMod.unitsMap_val]

lemma changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd' {m : ℕ} (hm : n ∣ m) {a : ℤ} (ha : IsCoprime a m) :
    changeLevel hm χ a = χ a := by
  rw [← ZMod.coe_unitOfIsCoprime _ ha, changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd _ hm, ZMod.coe_unitOfIsCoprime,
    ZMod.cast_intCast hm]

/-- The minimum natural number level `n` through which `χ` factors. -/
noncomputable def conductor : ℕ := sInf (conductorSet χ)

lemma conductor_mem_conductorSet : conductor χ ∈ conductorSet χ :=
  Nat.sInf_mem (Set.nonempty_of_mem (level_mem_conductorSet χ))

lemma conductor_dvd_level : conductor χ ∣ n := (conductor_mem_conductorSet χ).dvd

lemma factorsThrough_conductor : FactorsThrough χ (conductor χ) := conductor_mem_conductorSet χ

lemma conductor_ne_zero [NeZero n] : conductor χ ≠ 0 :=
  fun h ↦ NeZero.ne n <| Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd <| h ▸ conductor_dvd_level _

/-- The primitive character associated to a Dirichlet character. -/
noncomputable def primitiveCharacter : DirichletCharacter R χ.conductor :=
  Classical.choose (factorsThrough_conductor χ).choose_spec

theorem changeLevel_primitiveCharacter :
    (changeLevel χ.conductor_dvd_level) χ.primitiveCharacter = χ :=
  (factorsThrough_conductor χ).choose_spec.choose_spec.symm

lemma primitiveCharacter_isPrimitive : IsPrimitive (χ.primitiveCharacter) := by
  by_cases h : χ.conductor = 0
  · rw [isPrimitive_def]
    convert! conductor_eq_zero_iff_level_eq_zero.mpr h
  · exact le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h) (conductor_dvd_level _)) <|
      conductor_le_conductor_mem_conductorSet <| conductor_mem_conductorSet χ

lemma primitiveCharacter_one [NeZero n] : (1 : DirichletCharacter R n).primitiveCharacter = 1 := by
  have : NeZero (conductor (1 : DirichletCharacter R n)) :=
    ⟨@conductor_one R _ n _ ▸ Nat.one_ne_zero⟩
  rw [eq_one_iff_conductor_eq_one,
    (isPrimitive_def _).1 (1 : DirichletCharacter R n).primitiveCharacter_isPrimitive,
    conductor_one]

theorem primitiveCharacter_apply_of_isCoprime {a : ℤ} (ha : IsCoprime a n) :
    χ.primitiveCharacter a = χ a := by
  rw [← changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd' χ.primitiveCharacter χ.conductor_dvd_level ha,
    changeLevel_primitiveCharacter]

variable {F : Type*} [NormedField F] {n : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter F n)

namespace DirichletCharacter

/-- The value at a unit of a Dirichlet character with target a normed field has norm `1`. -/
@[simp] lemma unit_norm_eq_one (a : (ZMod n)ˣ) : ‖χ a‖ = 1 := by
  refine (pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (Nat.card_pos (α := (ZMod n)ˣ)).ne').mp ?_
  rw [← norm_pow, ← map_pow, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, pow_card_eq_one', Units.val_one, map_one,
    norm_one]

/-- The values of a Dirichlet character with target a normed field have norm bounded by `1`. -/
lemma norm_le_one (a : ZMod n) : ‖χ a‖ ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases h : IsUnit a
  · exact (χ.unit_norm_eq_one h.unit).le
  · rw [χ.map_nonunit h, norm_zero]
    exact zero_le_one

instance : MulCharClass (MulChar R R') R R' where
  map_mul χ := χ.map_mul'
  map_one χ := χ.map_one'
  map_nonunit χ := χ.map_nonunit' _

theorem map_nonunit (χ : MulChar R R') {a : R} (ha : ¬IsUnit a) : χ a = 0 :=
  χ.map_nonunit' a ha

variable {R : Type*} [CommMonoid R] [Fintype R] {R' : Type*} [CommRing R']

/-- The sum over all values of a nontrivial multiplicative character on a finite ring is zero
(when the target is a domain). -/
theorem sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one [IsDomain R'] {χ : MulChar R R'} (hχ : χ ≠ 1) : ∑ a, χ a = 0 := by
  rcases ne_one_iff.mp hχ with ⟨b, hb⟩
  refine eq_zero_of_mul_eq_self_left hb ?_
  simpa only [Finset.mul_sum, ← map_mul] using b.mulLeft_bijective.sum_comp _

instance fintype : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Fintype (ZMod n)
  | 0, h => (h.ne _ rfl).elim
  | n + 1, _ => Fin.fintype (n + 1)

instance infinite : Infinite (ZMod 0) :=
  Int.infinite

@[simp]
theorem card (n : ℕ) [Fintype (ZMod n)] : Fintype.card (ZMod n) = n := by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact (not_finite (ZMod 0)).elim
  | succ n => convert! Fintype.card_fin (n + 1) using 2

end

/-- So-named because the coercion is `Nat.cast` into `ZMod`. For `Nat.cast` into an arbitrary ring,
see `ZMod.natCast_val`. -/
theorem natCast_zmod_val {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (a : ZMod n) : (a.val : ZMod n) = a := by
  cases n
  · cases NeZero.ne 0 rfl
  · apply Fin.cast_val_eq_self

theorem natCast_rightInverse [NeZero n] : Function.RightInverse val ((↑) : ℕ → ZMod n) :=
  natCast_zmod_val

rw [← ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff', Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.cast_id]

theorem natCast_eq_natCast_iff (a b c : ℕ) : (a : ZMod c) = (b : ZMod c) ↔ a ≡ b [MOD c] := by
  simpa [Int.natCast_modEq_iff] using ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff a b c

theorem natCast_eq_natCast_iff' (a b c : ℕ) : (a : ZMod c) = (b : ZMod c) ↔ a % c = b % c :=
  ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff a b c

theorem intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ) : (a : ZMod b) = 0 ↔ (b : ℤ) ∣ a := by

rw [Units.val_mul, val_mul, natCast_mod]

lemma isUnit_iff_coprime (m n : ℕ) : IsUnit (m : ZMod n) ↔ m.Coprime n := by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun H ↦ (unitOfCoprime m H).isUnit⟩
  have H' := val_coe_unit_coprime H.unit
  rw [IsUnit.unit_spec, val_natCast, Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one] at H'
  rw [Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, Nat.gcd_comm, ← H']
  exact Nat.gcd_rec n m

@[to_additive]
theorem prod_eq_single_of_mem {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} (a : ι) (h : a ∈ s)
    (h₀ : ∀ b ∈ s, b ≠ a → f b = 1) : ∏ x ∈ s, f x = f a := by
  calc
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = ∏ x ∈ {a}, f x := by
      { refine (prod_subset ?_ ?_).symm
        · intro _ H
          rwa [mem_singleton.1 H]
        · simpa only [mem_singleton] }
    _ = f a := prod_singleton _ _

@[to_additive]
theorem prod_eq_single {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} (a : ι) (h₀ : ∀ b ∈ s, b ≠ a → f b = 1)
    (h₁ : a ∉ s → f a = 1) : ∏ x ∈ s, f x = f a :=
  haveI := Classical.decEq ι
  by_cases (prod_eq_single_of_mem a · h₀) fun this =>
    (prod_congr rfl fun b hb => h₀ b hb <| by rintro rfl; exact this hb).trans <|
      prod_const_one.trans (h₁ this).symm

@[bound]
theorem rpow_pos_of_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (y : ℝ) : 0 < x ^ y := by
  rw [rpow_def_of_pos hx]; apply exp_pos

(H1.gcd_mul_left_cancel n).trans H2

theorem Coprime.mul_right (H1 : Coprime k m) (H2 : Coprime k n) : Coprime k (m * n) :=
  (H1.symm.mul_left H2.symm).symm

⟨fun h => ⟨h.coprime_mul_right, h.coprime_mul_left⟩,
   fun ⟨h, _⟩ => by rwa [coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, h.gcd_mul_left_cancel n]⟩

theorem coprime_mul_iff_right : Coprime k (m * n) ↔ Coprime k m ∧ Coprime k n := by
  rw [@coprime_comm k, @coprime_comm k, @coprime_comm k, coprime_mul_iff_left]
